description: Sensor edition of iaiops — connect one industrial sensor and read it correctly: draft a sensor profile from a vendor IODD, check it, read one channel once with its unit, accuracy band and verification level, then collect. Covers sensors on Modbus RTU/TCP (RS-485 / RS-232 / RS-422 / USB serial, 4–20 mA via I/O modules), IO-Link masters (JSON interface) and MQTT/Sparkplug nodes. Use when the task mentions a sensor, sensor profile, IODD, IO-Link device, process data / pdin, decoding registers into engineering units, float32 word order, sentinel / no-target values, Modbus RTU instruments (RS-485 / RS-232), or "接一个传感器 / 传感器描述 / 读不懂寄存器 / 单位". The sensor tools are read-only and never write config; the server also exposes mqtt_publish (HIGH, MOC-gated) via the MQTT/Sparkplug set.
